{{Infobox Mechanic |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Climb Speed Up Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Climb Speed Up Icon.png |Sprite EoW= File:EoW Wall-Climb Speed Up Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK, EoW |other= |purpose= |related= {{List| * [[Added Effect]] * [[Armor]] * [[Cooking]] }} }} {{Term/Store|Wall-Climb Speed Up||Series, EoW}},{{Exp Game|EoW}} also known as {{Term/Store|Climb Speed Up||BotW, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Overview== ==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}=== In both {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, Climb Speed Up is an [[Added Effect]] that increases [[Link]]'s [[Climbing]] speed by 20%, 30%, and 40% for levels one, two, and three respectively. [[Stamina]] drain is increased to match, meaning it does not increase the total distance that can be climbed. It stacks multiplicatively with the [[Sideways Climbing Speed Up]] Effect imparted by [[Ravio's Hood]], and it has a maximum potency of level three. The following [[Armor]] pieces grant Climb Speed Up when worn: {{Gallery List|Items |TotK= Climber's Bandanna, Climbing Gear, Climbing Boots }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== Wall-Climb Speed Up is an [[Added Effect]] that increases the rate at which [[Princess Zelda]] [[Climbing|Climbs]] along [[Stone Wall]]s and [[Ladder]]s. It is granted by wearing the [[Climbing Band]]. The Effect can also be temporarily gained by consuming [[Potion]]s and [[Smoothie]]s with "Climbing" in their names, all of which are made using [[Rocktato]]es.
